description: This script processes XML test reports to identify disabled tests that should be re-enabled or are flaky, and uploads the results to S3. It interacts with AWS S3, handles test report parsing, and manages test status data.

methods.name: process_report
methods.description: Parses an XML report to count how many times tests are green or red, identifying flaky or failing tests.

methods.name: get_test_reports
methods.description: Collects test report XML files from S3 and GitHub Actions artifacts.

methods.name: get_disabled_test_name
methods.description: Converts a test ID into a tuple with a formatted name and its components.

methods.name: prepare_record
methods.description: Prepares a data record for a test to be uploaded to S3.

methods.name: save_results
methods.description: Saves the analysis results to S3, indicating which tests should be re-enabled or are flaky.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that aggregates test statuses across reports and triggers saving results.
